chesterfield.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Chesterfield
s1loc: Chesterfield's live scene runs through its two Grade II-listed council theatres. The Victorian Pomegranate Theatre stages West End musicals, tribute concerts and pantomime, while the Winding Wheel Theatre, the old Picture House, carries concerts, comedy and dance. Out in the open, the council fills the calendar with fairs, markets and pop concerts in Queen's Park and other green spaces. Behind each show sit the crews who rig, steward and run front-of-house through the season.

And the trade runs at every size here. Chesterfield Theatres and the larger seasonal park events run sizeable crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers across the town and the wider Derbyshire fringe need just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier has to serve the busy theatre season and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts for managed reordering and seasonal intake and direct online ordering side by side.
